title: Migration import fails with an opaque SQLite error when its staged file path passes the Windows path limit
outcome: Importing into a deep directory on Windows either works or refuses with a message that names the path length, instead of 'unable to open database file'.
acceptance: A test imports into an output directory whose staged .engram-migration-<uuid>.tmp-wal path exceeds 260 characters on Windows and either succeeds or refuses with an error that names the path length
full-store-migration.md tells the operator to keep the output path short, or the limit no longer applies

completion.summary: Windows migration import refuses oversized destination, staging and sidecar paths before filesystem probes or creation, names measured UTF-16 length and shorter-output remedy, and documents the limit in operator guidance and CLI help.
